title: Topics in Syntax; The Meaning of Melody and Stress
description: How does speech melody and stress affect the meaning of what we say? In this seminar, we will address this question by investigating two related areas of linguistics: the semantics and pragmatics of both focus and intonational contour. We will read primary and secondary literature in the subfields of semantics, pragmatics, and prosody, with a focus on linguistic theory, and including some experimental work.
